positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
• Developed commercial multi-tier ticketing application using Java, JQuery, and CSS
• Collaborate with different software engineers in multiple Agile teams to deliver new features and improve existing software every sprint
• Design, research and integrate modern technologies with existing legacy platforms without performance loss
• Adapt constantly to new technological trends and apply them to work environments to improve workflow and product efficiency
• Pioneered an API Automated Testing Framework based on Java and TestNG for the company, leading to efficient automation testing of 687 APIs (and growing) and freeing at least 10 hours of regression and smoketest every day.
• Implemented a Ruby on Rails application to analyze and graphically report the test results above every deployment

positions.title: Web Developer
positions.description:
•	Design and implement different Ruby on Rails applications for the center using MySQL, JavaScript and AJAX
•	Utilize the YUI library to build dynamic and interactive front-end user interfaces
•	Use version control software (Subversion and Git) daily to coordinate work with other developers and deploy projects to production environment
•	Facilitate record searching by open source full-text search indexer such as Sphinx 
•	Internationalize and localize the center's web applications (using JavaScript I18N framework) to facilitate the work of thousands of foreign employees and volunteers
•	Build MS Access front-end with SQL Server using JDBC Drivers by request of the center's supervisors for bookkeeping purposes
•	Write daily backup routines to synchronize essential data between network locations and external drives
•	Analyze the needs for new application features and create innovative solutions
•	Report directly to the Center's supervisor
•	Visit the site at: http://immigrants.byu.edu

company.name: BYU Center for Family History and Genealogy

positions.title: Academic Programmer
positions.locationName: BYU Office of Information Technology, Provo, Utah
positions.description:
•	Worked in a team of five developers under Agile (Scrum) software development practices to design and develop Java applications for the University
•	Developed the user interface for what the University Police office currently use to manage student parking
•	Helped design the University Gradebook system which is widely being used by both students and faculty to keep track of grades and assignments
•	Provided technical support for BYU Blackboard Educational System

honors.title: Spectra High Five Award (x2)
honors.description: I received this award at Spectra Ticketing for my promotion of teamwork and collaboration and also for my encouragement of change and creativity within the department. I received this once in 2015 through my Director of Software Engineering and once in 2016 through a Senior Software Engineer.

organizations.description: ACM is the world’s largest educational and scientific computing society, delivers resources that advance computing as a science and a profession. ACM provides the computing field's premier Digital Library and serves its members and the computing profession with leading-edge publications, conferences, and career resources.
